name: styles-color-roles
goal: Styles explains primary, secondary, surface, text and status color roles with actual variables, usage guidance and responsive examples for component authors.

evidence: Daniel requested role-based color guidance for component agents. Existing Styles tests cover token inventory but omit role meaning; preserve palette and test all three widths.
Opus implemented eight color roles without changing the canonical palette. Product commit c7f64aa41; all three standard catalog viewports pass unchanged assertions.
Paired retained red f31a1881 and green 60cf842f use unchanged tests and matching runtime. Reports 731 tests, lint, audit and both typechecks pass; actual route proof and integration remain pending.
